we can perform sentiment analysis using the rule based or lexical approaches.

the sentiment analysis of tweets on Twitter using lexical approach.
the analysis of the sentiments of the people of Pakistan regarding the political parties and their leaders.

the lexical approach is a good approach to use for sentiment analysis but it has its limitations and is not as accurate as the supervised approach.
